description: Fixed-weight 0-100 safety score for an EVM token (Base, Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon): contract (40 pts: honeypot, taxes, verified source, proxy), liquidity (30 pts: deepest DEX pair) and holder spread (30 pts: top-10 holder share). Shows each part. It is a heuristic from two public sources, not a security audit. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
